name: seenode
description: Deploy, troubleshoot, and manage applications, databases, domains, and projects on Seenode via the hosted Seenode MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy and manage apps on Seenode
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Seenode to deploy GitHub/GitLab apps, inspect logs and metrics, manage environment variables, attach custom domains, and work with existing MySQL/PostgreSQL databases. Authentication uses OAuth against the hosted Seenode MCP — no API keys in plugin config.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this repository to Seenode as a web app
Why did my latest Seenode deployment fail?
List my Seenode applications and their deploy status
